card.name: OVERDOSAGE in cross-references
card.fires_on: The first part of the word OVERDOSAGE (or OVERDOSE) when it appears in a cross-reference such as "see WARNINGS and OVERDOSAGE". It fires in drug-label section pointers inside parentheses or brackets.

modes.label: Cross-reference list
modes.description: OVER after a list of section names and the word "and", pointing to the overdosage section.

modes.label: Single reference
modes.description: OVER right after "see" or "under" as the only section pointed to.

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with the next letters of the heading, though the listed tokens look mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It marks the start of the heading OVERDOSAGE when a label points the reader to that section.
